# XLSB fixtures

Real Excel binary workbooks, copied from the calamine test suite
(<https://github.com/tafia/calamine/tree/master/tests>, MIT license,
Copyright 2016-2026 Johann Tuffe).

- `date.xlsb`: dates and a `[h]:mm:ss` duration
- `issues.xlsb`: mixed types, shared strings, formulas, special characters, a VBA project
